ruleset.name: sail-test
ruleset.description: The test-code rules every module is held to, with Helios's limits, documented in the "Quality gate" section of AGENTS.md. pmd-test-pending.xml holds the rest of Helios's test rule set, the families not yet clean, which the build does not read; the two together are Helios's set. The pending set only shrinks: the pull request that makes a family clean moves its rules here, unchanged, and the last one deletes that file.

rule.message: if statements are nested 3 or more deep (limit: a depth of 2)
The class has more than 15 non-static, non-final fields
The switch averages 10 or more statements per label (limit: fewer than 10)

rule.name: OnDemandImport
rule.message: On-demand (wildcard) imports are not allowed; import each type or static member by name.
rule.description: Every import names exactly one type or static member.
